name: Marianna Dąmbska

events.note: The Venice resident's dispatch of 14 December 1796 speaks of her death. Żychliński (1891, p. 221, n. 1) has her die at Padua on 2 September 1797, aged 38; the documents are taken.

notes: Of Lubraniec, arms Godziemba; daughter of Józef Dąmbski, castellan of Kowal, and Barbara Komorowska.
